title: Halloween
blurb: The most forked series in horror. Three timelines branch from the 1978 original, two of them pretending the others never happened, plus a remake and a standalone with no Michael Myers.

h82.t: Halloween III: Season of the Witch

h88.t: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers

h89.t: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers

h95.t: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers

groups.title: The original timeline
groups.note: Michael Myers from 1978 to 1995, carried on by Halloween 4 to 6.

groups.title: Halloween III
groups.note: A standalone story with no Michael Myers at all.

groups.title: The H20 timeline
groups.note: Follows Halloween II and ignores parts 4 to 6.

groups.title: Rob Zombie's remakes
groups.note: A fresh retelling, unconnected to anything else.

groups.title: The 2018 trilogy
groups.note: Follows the 1978 film only and ignores every other sequel.

note: There is no single correct order here, so each timeline is its own section. The 1978 film is the starting point for the original timeline, the H20 timeline and the 2018 trilogy; watch it first, then pick a branch. Halloween III has nothing to do with Michael Myers and can be watched any time.
